stature.basis: Drawn as an Anglo-American discharged soldier: Wau-Bun says the people outside the fort were "a few discharged soldiers and some families of half-breeds", and the three deserters were "two half-breeds and a Frenchman" (Quaife). Which of the six was which is ours.
